hook: Raat ke teen baje, sukhe kuan se kisi ne mera naam pukara.
hook_text: Kuen se aayi mere bachpan ki awaaz…
feedback: Great opening hook with the 3 AM well call. The tension ramps up nicely with the pebble throw and the sudden voice. To push the emotion higher, add a quick detail about Sameer thinking of his mother's warning before he throws the stone. Visual descriptions are sharp and atmospheric with the cold blue moonlight contrast. CUTS: only 11; write 16-24 cuts of ~2-3 s each, one line per cut, cutting between speaker and listener close-ups. STYLE: this series is told by a storyteller: make 85-95% of lines narration, with only 2-5 short key character lines.
lines: Raat ke teen baje, sukhe kuan se kisi ne mera naam pukara.
Ye kahani hai Rampur gaon ki, jahan raat gehraate hi sab sunsaan ho jata hai.
Sameer akela kheto ke paas se guzar raha tha.
Gaon ka niyam tha, is sukhe kuan me raat ko patthar mat fenko.
Par josh me akar Sameer ne ek chhota patthar andar fenk diya.
Aur tabhi gehrai se awaaz goonji <short pause> 'Sameer beta…'
Vo bina peechhe dekhe apne ghar ki taraf bhaga.
Bhaagte hue usne ghar ka darwaza khatkhataya.
Darwaza band karte hi maa rote hue uthi aur boli...
Tune darwaza kyu khola? Bua toh bahar khadi tujhe bula rahi hai.
